description: This file defines a generic class BasicExpiringValue that implements an interface ExpiringValue. It represents a value with an associated expiration time, providing methods to retrieve the value and check if it has expired based on a timestamp.

classes.name: BasicExpiringValue
classes.description: A generic class that encapsulates a value of type T with an expiration timestamp, implementing the ExpiringValue interface.

methods.name: BasicExpiringValue
methods.description: Constructor initializing the value and its expiration time, ensuring neither is null.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the value has expired based on the current time.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the value has expired based on a provided Instant.
